what: Live-session bar packs (RTH 1-minute SIP bars, full live universe + daily bars) on GitHub Releases bars-<YYYY-MM>, assets 1min-<day>.parquet / 1day-<day>.parquet (store-bars workflow)
headroom: GitHub Release assets: 2 GB per file limit; largest asset 17 MB (0.9% of the limit). One release per month keeps each release to ~21 sessions (~0.35 GB/month at the current size); no total-size limit is documented for releases, ~4.2 GB/year.
